title: NanophotonicsLab — browser-based nanophotonics tools and optics library
description: Interactive browser-based tools for nanophotonics (Mie scattering, plasmonics, EELS/CL, dipole decay and Purcell factors, optical tweezers, photothermal heating, ultrafast pulse dispersion) and the typed, tested, zero-dependency TypeScript library behind them (@nanophotonicslab/optics).
